name: encoding_comment_guard_with_japanese_text
notes: Plan §2: positions are UTF-16 code units. `日本語の注釈` is 6 BMP chars = 6 UTF-16 units but 18 UTF-8 bytes; the comment guard must convert before scanning, otherwise the byte offset lands past the line end (or inside a codepoint).
doc: A c4 ; 日本語の注釈

name: encoding_platform_command_start_column_multibyte
notes: D5 + plan §2: the replace range must be computed in UTF-16 units. Inside `'…'` the start column is the character after the last whitespace: `あ` occupies one UTF-16 unit (3 bytes), so the range is 5..7, not 7..9 (bytes).

name: encoding_rate_offset_after_multibyte_path
notes: D8 + plan §2: a PCM path with Japanese directory names. Tokenisation is quote-aware and the (empty) word range sits at UTF-16 column 23 — the same line is 29 UTF-8 bytes long.

name: encoding_command_fallback_after_multibyte_whitespace
notes: §3.1-17/§3.1-18: trailing whitespace after Japanese track text must reach the 37-item command fallback without token_at slicing inside UTF-8.

name: encoding_range_uses_nonzero_cursor_line
notes: §3.1-18: a multi-line document must preserve the cursor line in both endpoints of an explicit completion range.
